extracted.name: Baked feta & bean salad
extracted.description: Use leftovers from our summer bean stew as the base to make this salad, tossed with asparagus and green pepper. It's topped with honey-baked feta
ingredient_lines: ½-1 tsp chilli flakes (depending on your preference for heat)
small handful of mint leaves picked and finely chopped
200g asparagus cut into small pieces or peeled into ribbons
1kg leftover summery beans, drained (see recipe above)
3 tbsp leftover herby green aïoli (see recipe above)
instruction_lines: Heat the grill to high. Put the feta in a baking dish and drizzle over the oil and honey, then scatter over the fennel seeds and chilli flakes. Pop under the grill for 7-10 mins until bubbling and charred at the edges. Remove and leave to cool slightly.

Meanwhile, toss the mint, asparagus, pepper, drained beans and salad leaves together. For the dressing, mix the vinegar, aïoli and mustard together, and season to taste, adding a splash of water if needed to make it a drizzling consistency. Pour this over the salad leaves and toss together.
Break the feta into chunks over the salad and drizzle over any juices from the baking dish. Serve with toasted ciabatta, if you like.
